leftEvidence.title: Humans are sent out and the tree of life is guarded

points.label: Tree of life
points.left: Access is guarded after the humans leave Eden.
points.right: The tree bears fruit and healing leaves within the city.

points.label: Presence
points.left: Humans are sent from the garden.
points.right: God’s servants see his face and serve before the throne.

points.label: Light
points.left: The Eden scene does not center a permanent-light claim.
points.right: There is no night and God gives light.

payload.posture: Let the two endings face each other without reducing Revelation to a simple reversal diagram.

rightEvidence.title: Tree of life, river, throne, and unending light stand open in the city

payload.tension: Genesis ends with the tree of life guarded after exile, while Revelation presents tree, river, throne, healing, and open service in the city.
payload.title: Guarded life / open life
